name: useWifiRTT
summary: Fine Timing Measurement (FTM / 802.11az) indoor centimeter-level positioning.
plain: Measures round-trip time (RTT) distance between the phone and nearby Wi-Fi access points to determine indoor location within 1 to 2 meters without GPS.
description: Utilizes android.net.wifi.rtt.WifiRttManager for 802.11mc / 802.11az Fine Timing Measurement ranging. Discovers RTT-capable access points and measures exact flight time in picoseconds, returning calculated distances in millimeters with standard deviation accuracy metrics. Operates indoors where satellite GNSS signals are obstructed.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the device hardware features the Wi-Fi RTT ranging subsystem.

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the Wi-Fi RTT ranging service is currently active and available.

returns.name: isRanging
returns.desc: Whether an active RTT ranging sweep is currently in progress.

returns.name: rangingResults
returns.desc: Latest distance measurements to specified AP BSSIDs in millimeters.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if RTT service probing or ranging execution failed.

returns.name: startRanging
returns.desc: Initiates an active round-trip time ranging request against specified AP BSSIDs.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-checks the availability status of the Wi-Fi RTT service.

actions.name: startRanging(bssids)
actions.desc: Performs round-trip time distance ranging to target BSSIDs.

agentNote: Requires Android 9+ (API 28+) and location permissions. Access points must support 802.11mc or 802.11az FTM responders.
